old_value: Anthropic expected to begin marketing an IPO in mid-October 2026, at a valuation some investors put near $2 trillion.
new_value: Marketing now targeted for the week of November 9 at the earliest, with trading before Thanksgiving (November 26) and an investor day on October 14. The valuation talk is still $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion, and the date could move again.
headline: Anthropic's IPO slips about a month, to a mid-November marketing launch
so_what: Anthropic stays private, and in a pre-IPO quiet period, through most of Q4 deal cycles. Reps should plan for its prospectus numbers ($4.6 billion of 2025 revenue against an operating loss above $8 billion) to become public talking points by mid-November. Until a listing date is fixed, no current deal changes.

old_value: Anthropic pushed its IPO back about a month, targeting marketing as early as the week of November 9 and trading before Thanksgiving.
new_value: No public S-1 yet. A leaked draft shows a $42B 2025 net loss, $518B in compute commitments, $20.28B in cash and about a quarter of revenue from two customers. The listing is likely after the midterms.
headline: Anthropic's leaked S-1: $42B 2025 loss, and two customers bring in a quarter of revenue
so_what: When a buyer asks about vendor stability, reps can cite Anthropic's own risk factors: two customers bring in a quarter of its revenue, and $518B in spending commitments sit against $20B in cash. Point out that most of the loss is a non-cash charge. Overstating it will cost credibility.

new_value: A Sherman Act class action names Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google over the September 12 slowdown pact.
headline: Antitrust suit names both Anthropic and OpenAI over the AI slowdown pact
so_what: Reps should not use this suit against Anthropic, because OpenAI is a co-defendant and the buyer will notice. If a regulated buyer cites Anthropic's safety leadership, reps can say that the pacing plan Amodei proposed is now the main exhibit in an antitrust case. That fact belongs in the safety-brand objection.

old_value: Claude Tag, a persistent Slack teammate launched June 2026, replaced the older Claude in Slack app.
new_value: Claude Tag is still in beta. As of September 24, users' own connectors work in channels, with admin-enforced review planned for Enterprise. The rollout is Team-first, so Enterprise does not have it yet.
headline: Claude Tag adds per-user connectors in Slack channels, but Enterprise waits
so_what: Anthropic just fixed a real gap: Claude Tag now uses each person's existing access, so data permissions follow the user. Reps facing an Enterprise buyer can point out that the feature has not reached Enterprise plans and that Claude Tag is still labeled beta.

old_value: Workspace Agents (April 2026) plug into Slack and other apps
new_value: Dots always-on agents work through ChatGPT, Slack and Teams, with a shared Space for people and agents
headline: OpenAI launches Dots and ChatGPT Space, with agents that live in Slack and Teams
so_what: Reps can now say OpenAI has a persistent agent that works in both Slack and Teams and keeps shared team documents current, while Claude Tag runs only in Slack. Use it in any deal where the buyer runs both chat platforms. Enterprise access is beta and admin-enabled, and specialist Dot pricing is unpublished, so do not quote a price.

headline: OpenAI run rate nears $70B, up 70% since the start of Q3
so_what: When a buyer cites Anthropic's revenue lead, reps can answer with the current number: OpenAI's run rate is almost $70 billion and business revenue more than doubled this quarter. The figure comes from Axios sources, so say 'reported'.

old_value: GPT-5.6 is the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot (July 2026)
new_value: Specialist Dots are being integrated with Microsoft Agent 365 governance (pilot stage)
headline: OpenAI and Microsoft line up Agent 365 governance for specialist Dots
so_what: For Microsoft-heavy buyers, reps can say OpenAI's agents are being built to be managed with the identity and security tools the buyer already runs. This is a pilot-stage integration, so describe it as in progress.
